criteria.statement: The smoke script exists and its unit tests pass
The script defines READY_DEADLINE_MS (30 000), REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS and SOL_RING_ORACLE_ID, and the tests assert the deadline and a per-request timeout
Unit tests cover the pass/fail rules, including health 200 with card 404, child exit before ready, deadline passed, and empty oracleText
Unit tests assert the child environment drops the four variables and the child is stopped on pass and on fail
npm run smoke:built-server exits 0 locally and prints boot time and both statuses
After the smoke run no process listens on the port it used
smoke:built-server is in quality:check and npm run test:scripts passes including the parity guard
The built-server job sets timeout-minutes, uses Node 24, has no if/path filter, no id-token and no frontend build step, each asserted by a parity test
deploy.needs lists built-server, asserted by the parity test
NFR-020 exists in non-functional-requirements.md matching the accepted text and NFR-012's note says 7 jobs
REQ-166 names built-server, the health route purposes list has the CI boot check line, and the system-map guardrails entry names built-server, scripts/smoke-built-server.mjs and NFR-020
npm run typecheck, lint and format:check pass
No new dependency is added and the script reads or writes no secret, .env or .secrets path
